```{r setup1}
set.seed(42)

# ---------------------------
# Core: build design matrix from formula
# ---------------------------
# This is the key AVM-ish piece:
# - formula defines predictors
# - model.matrix makes your X
# - terms + xlevels are saved for consistent future encodes
#
make_design <- function(df,
                        formula,
                        terms_obj = NULL,
                        xlevels = NULL,
                        handle_new_levels = c("na", "drop", "error")) {

  handle_new_levels <- match.arg(handle_new_levels)

  # lock terms (training or reuse at inference)
  if (is.null(terms_obj)) {
    terms_obj <- terms(formula, data = df)
  }

  # --- CRITICAL: pre-sanitize factor columns BEFORE model.frame(xlev=...) ---
  # If we're using saved xlevels (test/inference), make sure df's factor columns
  # cannot contain unseen levels, otherwise model.frame will error immediately.
  if (!is.null(xlevels)) {
    fac_vars <- intersect(names(xlevels), names(df))

    for (v in fac_vars) {
      # Work on a temporary vector so we don't mutate df unexpectedly unless needed
      col <- df[[v]]

      # Ensure it's character so we can safely compare levels/values
      if (is.factor(col)) col_chr <- as.character(col) else col_chr <- col

      # Only process if it’s character/factor-like (ignore numeric-coded cats)
      if (is.character(col_chr)) {
        unseen <- !is.na(col_chr) & !(col_chr %in% xlevels[[v]])

        if (any(unseen)) {
          new_vals <- unique(col_chr[unseen])

          if (handle_new_levels == "error") {
            stop(sprintf(
              "New factor levels found in '%s': %s",
              v, paste(new_vals, collapse = ", ")
            ))
          }

          if (handle_new_levels == "drop") {
            # drop offending rows
            df <- df[!unseen, , drop = FALSE]
            # need to update col_chr after dropping
            col_chr <- df[[v]]
            if (is.factor(col_chr)) col_chr <- as.character(col_chr)
          } else if (handle_new_levels == "na") {
            # convert unseen to NA (LightGBM handles missing well)
            col_chr[unseen] <- NA_character_
          }
        }

        # Now lock factor levels to training levels
        df[[v]] <- factor(col_chr, levels = xlevels[[v]])
      }
    }
  }

  # Build model.frame using locked terms (now safe with xlev)
  mf <- model.frame(terms_obj, data = df, na.action = na.pass, xlev = xlevels)

  # Capture xlevels during training
  if (is.null(xlevels)) {
    xlevels <- .getXlevels(terms_obj, mf)
  }

  # Response (if present)
  y <- model.response(mf)

  # Sparse one-hot design matrix
  X <- Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(terms_obj, mf)

  # Drop intercept if present
  if ("(Intercept)" %in% colnames(X)) {
    X <- X[, setdiff(colnames(X), "(Intercept)"), drop = FALSE]
  }

  list(
    X = X,
    y = y,
    terms = terms_obj,
    xlevels = xlevels,
    feature_names = colnames(X)
  )
}

# --- helper: set LightGBM feature names compatibly ---
set_lgb_feature_names <- function(dset, feature_names) {
  # Many builds support setting fields
  if (exists("lgb.Dataset.set.field", where = asNamespace("lightgbm"), inherits = FALSE)) {
    lightgbm::lgb.Dataset.set.field(dset, field_name = "feature_name", data = feature_names)
  }
  dset
}
```

```{r set2}
# ---------------------------
# Metrics (regression)
# ---------------------------
rmse <- function(y, yhat) sqrt(mean((y - yhat)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
mae  <- function(y, yhat) mean(abs(y - yhat), na.rm = TRUE)
r2   <- function(y, yhat) {
  ss_res <- sum((y - yhat)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  ss_tot <- sum((y - mean(y, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  1 - ss_res/ss_tot
}

# ---------------------------
# Train function (AVM regression)
# ---------------------------
train_lgbm_avm <- function(df, formula, test_frac = 0.2, handle_new_levels = "na",
                           params = list(
                             objective = "regression", metric = "rmse", learning_rate = 0.05,
                             num_leaves = 256, feature_fraction = 1, bagging_fraction = 1,
                             # numleaves=64 feature_fraction = 0.85 bagging_fraction = 0.85
                             bagging_freq = 1, min_data_in_leaf = 10, verbosity = -1 #dataleaf = 50
                           ), num_boost_round = 10000, early_stopping_rounds = 200) {
                              # num_boost_round = 5000 early_stopping_rounds = 100

  # Basic NA strategy:  # keep NAs in predictors; model.matrix will keep NA rows,
  # and LightGBM can handle missing values.  # But response must not be NA.
  resp_name <- all.vars(formula)[1]
  df <- df[!is.na(df[[resp_name]]), ]

  # Split
  n <- nrow(df)            # or df[, .N]
  idx_test  <- sample.int(n, size = floor(test_frac * n))
  idx_train <- setdiff(seq_len(n), idx_test)
  train_df <- df[idx_train, ] 
  test_df  <- df[idx_test, ]

  # Build train design (captures terms + xlevels)
  tr <- make_design(train_df, formula, handle_new_levels = handle_new_levels)

  # Build test design using locked terms + xlevels
  te <- make_design(test_df, formula, terms_obj = tr$terms,
                    xlevels = tr$xlevels, handle_new_levels = handle_new_levels)

  # Ensure feature alignment (model.matrix guarantees order if terms identical,
  # but we assert to be safe)
  if (!identical(tr$feature_names, te$feature_names)) {
    # Align test columns to train columns (in case of dropped rows or subtle diffs)
    # Add missing cols in test, drop extra cols.
    missing <- setdiff(tr$feature_names, te$feature_names)
    extra   <- setdiff(te$feature_names, tr$feature_names)

    if (length(missing) > 0) {
      add <- Matrix::Matrix(0, nrow = nrow(te$X), ncol = length(missing), sparse = TRUE)
      colnames(add) <- missing
      te$X <- cbind(te$X, add)
    }
    if (length(extra) > 0) {
      te$X <- te$X[, setdiff(colnames(te$X), extra), drop = FALSE]
    }
    # Reorder to match train
    te$X <- te$X[, tr$feature_names, drop = FALSE]
    te$feature_names <- colnames(te$X)
  }

  dtrain <- lgb.Dataset(data = tr$X, label = tr$y)
  dvalid <- lgb.Dataset(data = te$X, label = te$y)
  
  # ensure column names exist (important for importance tables)
  colnames(tr$X) <- tr$feature_names
  colnames(te$X) <- tr$feature_names

  # set names on datasets (safe no-op if not supported)
  dtrain <- set_lgb_feature_names(dtrain, tr$feature_names)
  dvalid <- set_lgb_feature_names(dvalid, tr$feature_names)

  booster <- lgb.train(
    params = params,  data = dtrain, nrounds = num_boost_round, valids = list(valid = dvalid),
    early_stopping_rounds = early_stopping_rounds, eval_freq = 50
  )

  pred_test <- predict(booster, te$X)

  metrics <- list(
    rmse = rmse(te$y, pred_test), mae = mae(te$y, pred_test), r2 = r2(te$y, pred_test)
  )

  importance <- lgb.importance(booster, percentage = TRUE)

  list(
    booster = booster,  formula = formula, terms = tr$terms, xlevels = tr$xlevels,
    feature_names = tr$feature_names, metrics = metrics, importance = importance
  )
}
```


```{r savemod, eval=FALSE}
# ---------------------------
# Save bundle (model + encoding contract)
# ---------------------------
save_avm_bundle <- function(fit, prefix = "lgbm_avm") {
  ts <- stamp()
  model_file <- file.path(OUT_DIR, sprintf("%s_%s.txt", prefix, ts))
  bundle_file <- file.path(OUT_DIR, sprintf("%s_%s_bundle.rds", prefix, ts))
  imp_file <- file.path(OUT_DIR, sprintf("%s_%s_importance.csv", prefix, ts))

  lgb.save(fit$booster, model_file)

  bundle <- list(
    model_file = model_file,
    formula = fit$formula,
    terms = fit$terms,
    xlevels = fit$xlevels,
    feature_names = fit$feature_names,
    best_iter = fit$booster$best_iter
  )
  saveRDS(bundle, bundle_file)

  fwrite(fit$importance, imp_file)

  list(model_file = model_file, bundle_file = bundle_file, imp_file = imp_file)
}
```



```{r predict, eval=FALSE}
# ---------------------------
# Predict helper (safe inference)
# ---------------------------
# Provide df_new (one row or many); uses saved terms/xlevels to build X in same feature space
predict_avm <- function(bundle_rds, df_new, handle_new_levels = "na") {
  bundle <- readRDS(bundle_rds)
  booster <- lgb.load(bundle$model_file)

  des <- make_design(df_new, bundle$formula,
                     terms_obj = bundle$terms,
                     xlevels = bundle$xlevels,
                     handle_new_levels = handle_new_levels)

  # Align columns to training feature set
  X <- des$X
  if (!identical(colnames(X), bundle$feature_names)) {
    missing <- setdiff(bundle$feature_names, colnames(X))
    extra   <- setdiff(colnames(X), bundle$feature_names)

    if (length(missing) > 0) {
      add <- Matrix::Matrix(0, nrow = nrow(X), ncol = length(missing), sparse = TRUE)
      colnames(add) <- missing
      X <- cbind(X, add)
    }
    if (length(extra) > 0) {
      X <- X[, setdiff(colnames(X), extra), drop = FALSE]
    }
    X <- X[, bundle$feature_names, drop = FALSE]
  }

  predict(booster, X)
}
```


```{r dhelp, eval=FALSE}
# ---------------------------
# Optional: AVM-ish "newdata_from_sale" helper
# ---------------------------
# Given a full df, pull one record by an id and return the row as newdata for predict_avm()
newdata_from_id <- function(df, id_col, id_value) {
  stopifnot(id_col %in% names(df))
  row <- df[get(id_col) == id_value]
  if (nrow(row) == 0) stop("No rows found for that id.")
  row
}

```

## Model I

```{r mod1}
# ==========================================================
# MAIN EXAMPLE (edit this to match your AVM variables)
# ==========================================================
# message("Reading data: ", DATA_PATH)
# df <- fread(DATA_PATH)
df <- dfa

# Example AVM formula: # - choose EXACTLY the variables you want
# - you can include factor() for categorical predictors
# - you can do transforms inside formula (log, poly, interactions, etc.)
#
# Typical price AVM:
#   ln_price ~ living_area + lot_area + beds + baths + year_built + factor(ecf) + factor(zip) + dist_downtown
#
# If you train on price directly: #   sale_price ~ ...
#
formula_time <- ln_sppsf ~ arterial + single_family1story + half_duplex1story + half_duplex2story +
  smallest + small + large + largest + two_plus_baths + powder_room +
  good + fair + poor + very_poor_unsound + qabove_avg + qbelow_avg +
  sresb_yearbuilt + crawl + slab + ln_garagespaces +
  fireplace + hot_water + elec_baseboard + wall + central_air + months

message("Training LightGBM AVM with formula-driven features...")
mod_time <- train_lgbm_avm(df, formula = formula_time)

message("\nHoldout metrics:")
print(mod_time$metrics)

message("\nTop 20 features by Gain:")
print(head(mod_time$importance[order(-Gain)], 20))

# art <- save_avm_bundle(fit)
# message("\nSaved artifacts:")
# print(art)
```

```{r}
compare_feature_sets <- function(df_a, df_b, prefix_ecf = "ecf_") {
  a <- names(df_a)
  b <- names(df_b)

  a_ecf <- a[startsWith(a, prefix_ecf)]
  b_ecf <- b[startsWith(b, prefix_ecf)]

  a_non <- setdiff(a, a_ecf)
  b_non <- setdiff(b, b_ecf)

  list(
    counts = data.frame(
      set = c("A", "B"),
      total_cols = c(length(a), length(b)),
      ecf_dummies = c(length(a_ecf), length(b_ecf)),
      non_ecf_cols = c(length(a_non), length(b_non))
    ),
    missing_in_B_non_ecf = setdiff(a_non, b_non),
    missing_in_A_non_ecf = setdiff(b_non, a_non),
    missing_in_B_ecf = setdiff(a_ecf, b_ecf),
    missing_in_A_ecf = setdiff(b_ecf, a_ecf)
  )
}

cmp <- compare_feature_sets(df_prepped2, df_prepped)

cmp$counts
head(cmp$missing_in_B_non_ecf, 50)   # columns present in 23–25 but missing in 22–24
head(cmp$missing_in_A_non_ecf, 50)   # columns present in 22–24 but missing in 23–25
```
